description.value:
Cosmic force propels you forward at extreme speed in a straight line. When you Cast this Spell, you Stride up to your full Speed in a straight line. You can move through the spaces of creatures during this movement. Each creature whose space you move through must attempt a basic Reflex save against your spell DC, taking 4d6 bludgeoning damage.

You ignore difficult terrain during this Stride and do not trigger Reactive Strikes from creatures you move through during the Stride.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone]{Prone}, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone]{Prone}, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
